the NIRF 2020 ranking of MHRD, GoI.)
Walk-in-Interview
for the position of Research Assistant
Applications are called for Walk-in-Interview for Research Assistant
position under RP-129 in ICSSR funded project purely on temporary &
contractual basis for 4 months (extendable up to 6 Months).
Title:
Did PM Garib KalyanYojana 2020 Work During COVID-19
Pandemic? Case study of some COVID 19 affected red zones of
Jammu and Kashmir.
Qualification:
Ph.D., M Phil, M.Sc./M.A. in Social Sciences from a recognized
University/Institute with 55 % marks or equivalent CGPA.
Remuneration: Rs. 20,000/- P.M.
Duration: 4 Months extendable up to 6 Months
Date & Time of Walk-in-Interview:
5th July 2021 at 11: 30 PM [Google Meet link will be shared on the
interview day]
Interested candidates may send their detailed CV along with documentary
proof at the following email id: a.billah@smvdu.ac.in
No. SMVDU/R&D/21/3690 Sd/-
Dated:24/06/2021 Dr Arif Billah Dar, Project Director RP-129
